mapper.sql:
SELECT mo.id AS record_id, 'MEMBERSHIP' AS record_type, mo.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, CONCAT(COALESCE(mp.name, '会员'), '会员订阅') AS title, mo.order_no, 'MEMBERSHIP' AS biz_type, mo.amount AS money_amount, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS points_amount,
'INCOME' 'EXPENSE' AS money_direction, 'NONE' AS points_direction, mo.payment_status AS status, mo.created_at FROM member_order mo LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = mo.user_id LEFT JOIN member_product mpr ON mpr.id = mo.product_id LEFT JOIN member_plan mp ON mp.id = mpr.plan_id
mo.user_id = #{userId}
UNION ALL
SELECT pro.id AS record_id, 'RECHARGE' AS record_type, pro.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, COALESCE(prp.name, '积分充值') AS title, pro.order_no, 'RECHARGE' AS biz_type, pro.actual_amount AS money_amount, pro.points + pro.gift_points AS points_amount,
'INCOME' 'EXPENSE' AS money_direction,
'EXPENSE' 'INCOME' AS points_direction, pro.status, pro.created_at FROM points_recharge_order pro LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = pro.user_id LEFT JOIN points_recharge_product prp ON prp.id = pro.product_id
pro.user_id = #{userId}
UNION ALL
SELECT pt.id AS record_id, 'POINTS' AS record_type, pt.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, CASE pt.biz_type WHEN 'MEMBER_GIFT' THEN '会员赠送' WHEN 'ACTIVITY_REWARD' THEN '活动奖励' WHEN 'SIGN_IN' THEN '签到奖励' WHEN 'COMPENSATION' THEN '系统补偿' WHEN 'REFUND' THEN '积分返还' WHEN 'AI_CHAT' THEN 'AI对话' WHEN 'IMAGE_GENERATE' THEN '图片生成' WHEN 'VOICE_GENERATE' THEN '语音生成' WHEN 'STORY_GENERATE' THEN '故事生成' WHEN 'ROLE_CREATE' THEN '角色创建' WHEN 'THREE_D_GENERATE' THEN '3D生成' WHEN 'ADVANCED_FEATURE' THEN '高级功能' WHEN 'ADMIN_ADD' THEN '后台增加' WHEN 'ADMIN_DEDUCT' THEN '后台扣减' ELSE pt.biz_type END AS title, pt.transaction_no AS order_no, pt.biz_type, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS money_amount, pt.amount AS points_amount, 'NONE' AS money_direction,
CASE pt.direction WHEN 'INCOME' THEN 'EXPENSE' ELSE 'INCOME' END
pt.direction AS points_direction, pt.status, pt.created_at FROM points_transaction pt LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = pt.user_id WHERE pt.status = 'SUCCESS' AND pt.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT ( pt.biz_type = 'RECHARGE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM points_recharge_order linked_order WHERE linked_order.points_transaction_no = pt.transaction_no ) )

sql.if: AND ( bill.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR bill.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR bill.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

if.test: query.category != null and query.category != '' and query.category != 'ALL'
query.moneyDirection != null and query.moneyDirection != '' and query.moneyDirection != 'ALL'
query.pointsDirection != null and query.pointsDirection != '' and query.pointsDirection != 'ALL'

choose.when: SELECT mo.id AS record_id, 'MEMBERSHIP' AS record_type, mo.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, CONCAT(COALESCE(mp.name, '会员'), '会员订阅') AS title, mo.order_no, 'MEMBERSHIP' AS biz_type, mo.amount AS money_amount, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS points_amount, 'INCOME''EXPENSE' AS money_direction, 'NONE' AS points_direction, mo.payment_status AS status, mo.created_at, mo.payment_channel, mpr.original_price AS original_amount, CASE WHEN mpr.original_price IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE mpr.original_price - mo.amount END AS discount_amount, mo.amount AS actual_amount, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS before_balance, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS after_balance, CAST(mo.product_id AS CHAR) AS related_biz_id, CONCAT('会员订单 ', mo.order_no) AS description, mo.pay_time FROM member_order mo LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = mo.user_id LEFT JOIN member_product mpr ON mpr.id = mo.product_id LEFT JOIN member_plan mp ON mp.id = mpr.plan_id WHERE mo.id = #{recordId} AND mo.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pro.id AS record_id, 'RECHARGE' AS record_type, pro.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, COALESCE(prp.name, '积分充值') AS title, pro.order_no, 'RECHARGE' AS biz_type, pro.actual_amount AS money_amount, pro.points + pro.gift_points AS points_amount, 'INCOME''EXPENSE' AS money_direction, 'EXPENSE''INCOME' AS points_direction, pro.status, pro.created_at, pro.payment_channel, pro.original_amount, pro.original_amount - pro.actual_amount AS discount_amount, pro.actual_amount, pt.before_balance, pt.after_balance, CAST(pro.product_id AS CHAR) AS related_biz_id, CONCAT('积分充值订单 ', pro.order_no) AS description, pro.pay_time FROM points_recharge_order pro LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = pro.user_id LEFT JOIN points_recharge_product prp ON prp.id = pro.product_id LEFT JOIN points_transaction pt ON pt.transaction_no = pro.points_transaction_no WHERE pro.id = #{recordId} AND pro.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
choose.otherwise:
SELECT pt.id AS record_id, 'POINTS' AS record_type, pt.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, COALESCE(pt.description, pt.biz_type) AS title, pt.transaction_no AS order_no, pt.biz_type, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS money_amount, pt.amount AS points_amount, 'NONE' AS money_direction,
CASE pt.direction WHEN 'INCOME' THEN 'EXPENSE' ELSE 'INCOME' END
pt.direction AS points_direction, pt.status, pt.created_at, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS payment_channel, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS original_amount, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS discount_amount, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS actual_amount, pt.before_balance, pt.after_balance, pt.biz_id AS related_biz_id, pt.description, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS pay_time FROM points_transaction pt LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = pt.user_id WHERE pt.id = #{recordId} AND pt.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bill.money_direction = 'INCOME' THEN bill.money_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS money_income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bill.money_direction = 'EXPENSE' THEN bill.money_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS money_expense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bill.points_direction = 'INCOME' THEN bill.points_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS points_income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bill.points_direction = 'EXPENSE' THEN bill.points_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS points_expense, COUNT(1) AS record_count FROM ( SELECT mo.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, mo.order_no, 'MEMBERSHIP' AS record_type, 'MEMBERSHIP' AS biz_type, mo.amount AS money_amount, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS points_amount, 'INCOME' AS money_direction, 'NONE' AS points_direction, mo.payment_status AS status, mo.created_at FROM member_order mo LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = mo.user_id UNION ALL SELECT pro.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, pro.order_no, 'RECHARGE', 'RECHARGE', pro.actual_amount, pro.points + pro.gift_points, 'INCOME', 'EXPENSE', pro.status, pro.created_at FROM points_recharge_order pro LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = pro.user_id UNION ALL SELECT pt.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.realname, ''), su.username) AS nickname, pt.transaction_no, 'POINTS', pt.biz_type, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2)), pt.amount, 'NONE', CASE pt.direction WHEN 'INCOME' THEN 'EXPENSE' ELSE 'INCOME' END, pt.status, pt.created_at FROM points_transaction pt LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = pt.user_id WHERE pt.status = 'SUCCESS' AND NOT ( pt.biz_type = 'RECHARGE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM points_recharge_order linked_order WHERE linked_order.points_transaction_no = pt.transaction_no ) ) ) bill WHERE 1 = 1
